cuts.reason: Hook scene. Depth gauge animation from 0-50m with color band dissolution. Opens on fade from black to avoid hard cold open.
Knowledge gap card. Hard cut in from sc01 for a brief visual reset; dissolve out into the mechanism.
O-H bond molecular diagram — the hero explanation scene. Dissolves in from the knowledge gap. Diagram elements animate in sequentially with narration.
Mechanism summary: 'The molecule vibrates. The photon vanishes.' Hard cuts on both sides — the rhythm break is intentional, no softening transitions.
50x hero stat card. Hard cut in for maximum impact. The 50x number is the video's sharpest visual moment — no dissolve softening.
Absorption spectrum bar chart — confirms the 50x claim visually. Dissolves out into the scale reveal.
Scale infographic — the humbling 95% dark ocean reveal. Slow dissolves on both sides to give this scene room to breathe.
Closing core message card. Dissolves in from the scale scene. Long fade to black on exit — ending should feel like settling into the deep, not cutting away.
